publication_scope: Derived numerical outcomes, no raw prompts, responses, source problem text, credentials or human labels.

consistency.reference_policy: Frozen official annotations; no sensitivity overrides.
consistency.invalid_policy: All-consistent requires 6 valid draws and 1 class. Divergent requires 6 valid draws and >=2 classes. Incomplete cases reported separately, retained in overall denominator.

ladder.observation_unit: problem; per-round rates use separate denominators
ladder.reference: Published official models; earlier sensitivity corrections remain a separate analysis.

reference_false_positive.denominator: All valid flagged transformed outputs; conditional on the published reference. Repeated transforms are not independent problems.

design.screening_protocol: Original distinct A/B prompts; reused existing pairs and additional same-version train/dev cases. Not the six identical T7 prompts.
